notes:
Resizable floating windows, easier-to-drag dialogs and a refined logo.

### New
- Floating windows (Objects, Groups, Blocks, Saved views, Command reference, Command history…) can be resized from any edge or corner. The size is remembered; double-click the title bar or use View > Reset layout to restore it.

### Improved
- Every dialog moves by a full-width title bar, including Layouts and Aliases.
- List rows give their icons and ⋯ more room.
- The View menu lists views first, then layout, CPlanes and settings.
- Objects… now opens from Organize only.
- Refined logo and app icon.

### Fixed
- Cancel in Grid settings and 3D mouse restores the previous values at once.

---
Windows x64 installer with signed automatic updates and the corresponding AGPL source code. The installer is not Authenticode-signed: on first install choose **More info > Run anyway**.
